name: Staff of Titania
blocked_sentences: Whenever equipped creature attacks, create a 1/1 green Forest Dryad land creature token. (It's affected by summoning sickness.)

needs.what: A Forest Dryad token in the closed `token_ids` pool -- `forest_dryad_1_1_g`, "1/1 green Forest Dryad land creature" -- added to data/cards/tokens.cards.json: `{"id": "forest_dryad_1_1_g", "name": "Forest Dryad Token", "types": ["Land", "Creature"], "subtypes": ["Forest", "Dryad"], "colors": ["G"], "color_identity": ["G"], "power": 1, "toughness": 1, "is_token": true, "abilities": [{"kind": "activated", "text": "{T}: Add {G}.", "is_mana_ability": true, "cost": {"tap": true}, "effects": [{"op": "add_mana", "mana": "{G}"}]}]}`. The characteristics are exactly the shipped card `dryad_arbor` (templates.cards.json: types ["Land", "Creature"], subtypes ["Forest", "Dryad"], 1/1, green) plus `is_token`, so the card model already supports a Land Creature -- only the token entry is missing. The explicit `{T}: Add {G}` ability is needed because the engine does NOT derive a basic land type's mana ability: BASIC_LAND_TYPES in src/automtg/engine/effects/values.py:211 is used only for domain counting, and data/cards/basics.cards.json writes Forest's mana ability out by hand. (Note that `dryad_arbor` itself was imported without one, so it currently taps for nothing; the token should not copy that.) This same token is printed by at least three other queued cards -- data/authoring/queue.json has it for Autumn Willow ("When Autumn Willow enters, create a 1/1 green Forest Dryad land creature token"), a "Create X 1/1 green Forest Dryad land creature tokens" card, and Jyoti -- so the one data entry unblocks four cards. Nothing else about this line needs engine work: the trigger is `{"event": "attacks", "filter": {"attached": true}}` -- `attacks` is in `trigger_events` and Equipment triggers on the equipped creature are already written this way -- and the effect is a plain `create_token`.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `token_ids` is a CLOSED list of 61 tokens and holds no Dryad, no Forest, and no Land-typed token of any kind (a scan of data/cards/tokens.cards.json for types containing "Land" and for the subtypes "Forest"/"Dryad" returns nothing), so `create_token` cannot name one and an invented id fails to load. The nearest bodies in the pool are `saproling_1_1_g` (1/1 green Saproling creature) and `insect_1_1_g` (1/1 green Insect creature): right size and colour, but both are creature-only tokens with no land types. Substituting either makes a materially different card, and in two directions at once -- the real token is a land, so it enters as a permanent that taps for {G} and, being a Forest, it also raises Staff of Titania's own first line ("+X/+X, where X is the number of Forests you control") by one for every token made. A Saproling raises neither. The brief forbids a nearly-right token, and the closest existing card, `dryad_arbor`, is a real card in the library, not something `create_token` can conjure.
